title: Maximal growth of the Stein-Wainger oscillatory integral
summary: We determine the optimal growth of the Stein--Wainger oscillatory integral for every Denjoy--Carleman class defined by a positive log-convex sequence. Quasianalyticity is equivalent to boundedness in $λ$ for every fixed phase in the class. In the nonquasianalytic case, an explicit formula in the defining sequence gives the optimal order, attained by a single phase for all sufficiently large frequencies.
